highlights.title: Minimize-safe execution feedback

faqs.question: What does LiveFlow Studio require?
faqs.answer: LiveFlow Studio targets Windows 10 or Windows 11 x64, requires Microsoft Edge WebView2, and needs internet access for login and network-backed features. Minecraft requires a compatible server or plugin, while Keystroke workflows require AutoIt from its official website.

faqs.question: Can I use the application without an active account?
faqs.answer: Production features are invite-only, but trusted application updates remain available from the login screen. The account must be active, claimed by its approved installation, and have a unique TikTok username before LiveFlow Studio can start its production services. Public-IP or VPN changes on the same verified installation do not require a reset.

faqs.question: What is the difference between the installer and portable ZIP?
faqs.answer: Both packages contain the same application version. The installer adds LiveFlow Studio to Windows normally; the portable ZIP can be extracted to a dedicated folder and run without installation.

faqs.question: Which TikTok LIVE interactions can trigger an Event?
faqs.answer: Events can respond to gifts, follows, shares, subscriptions, comments, and supported numeric conditions. Gift Events can use specific-gift priority, minimum coin fallback, cooldowns, and repeat-combo rules.

faqs.question: Do I need to connect TikTok LIVE manually every time?
faqs.answer: No. After login, the LIVE watcher checks the authorized username automatically and switches to the realtime listener when a valid active room is found. Check LIVE now is a manual recovery action, not a required connection step.

faqs.question: Does Saweria depend on the TikTok LIVE connection?
faqs.answer: No. Saweria Donation Alert and MediaShare use their own saved stream key and reconnect flow, so a Saweria Event can run even when TikTok LIVE is not connected.

faqs.question: What can an Action run?
faqs.answer: An Action can use animation, picture/GIF, video file, YouTube, alert, audio, Minecraft command, keystroke, Goal update, and Overlay Screen effects that have been configured in the editor. Any supported effect can be the only active effect in an Action.

faqs.question: Can I change an Action without reopening the editor?
faqs.answer: Yes. The Actions table can update duration, enable or disable an Action, and toggle configured Animation, Picture/GIF, Sound, Video, and YouTube effects without deleting their settings. At least one effect must remain active.

faqs.question: Can multiple Actions run at the same time?
faqs.answer: Non-keystroke Actions and their effects can start concurrently. Actions containing keystrokes use one global sequential queue to prevent competing keyboard automation. The Live Execution Log temporarily reports job and per-effect results.

faqs.question: Why do Test Action and Specific Gift simulation wait five seconds?
faqs.answer: The countdown gives you time to focus the intended desktop application before an Action runs. The delay is enforced by the backend, while other Event Simulator signals continue to run immediately.

faqs.question: What is required before using a Keystroke Action?
faqs.answer: Install AutoIt from its official download page, confirm that Emergency Stop is not active, and use Required foreground app when the shortcut must only reach one application. LiveFlow Studio does not bundle or install AutoIt automatically.

faqs.question: Which realtime overlays are available?
faqs.answer: The production application supports eight Overlay Screens, Goal Overlays, and Overlay Gallery widgets for Gift Feed, Chat, Top Gifter, and Top Liker. Their HTTPS URLs can be added as Browser Sources in OBS or TikTok LIVE Studio.

faqs.question: Must the desktop application stay open for overlays?
faqs.answer: Yes for live publishing and local media. LiveFlow Studio must remain open, logged in, and online while local picture/GIF or video media is relayed. Realtime session content is not stored as permanent event history.

faqs.question: Where are settings, credentials, and media stored?
faqs.answer: Account-scoped operational settings are stored in local SQLite. Supported integration secrets are stored in Windows Credential Manager. Audio, pictures, videos, and gift icons remain in the local media folder.

faqs.question: Does exported JSON contain audio files or account secrets?
faqs.answer: No. Export does not embed audio, local picture/video files, login sessions, TikTok identity, private overlay URLs, or integration credentials. It carries the portable configuration needed to rebuild the setup safely.

faqs.question: What happens to missing media during import?
faqs.answer: Preflight reports missing media before changes are applied. Approved MyInstants audio can be restored from its validated original source. Missing local picture/GIF or video paths are discarded and affected Actions remain disabled for review.

faqs.question: Can a configuration be imported into another account?
faqs.answer: Yes. Import preserves the destination identity and remaps Action and Event IDs with their references. It creates an automatic backup, disables global Actions, and leaves sensitive imported Actions disabled until reviewed. Older Timer data is safely ignored.

faqs.question: How are application updates verified?
faqs.answer: LiveFlow Studio checks, downloads, and installs updates from the login screen without requiring a Supabase account. It only accepts assets from the official public release repository and verifies the Ed25519-signed manifest, anti-rollback sequence, download host, size, and SHA-256 before Windows is allowed to open the installer.

faqs.question: Why can Windows show Unknown Publisher or SmartScreen?
faqs.answer: The current installer is not commercially code-signed. Download only from the official release repository and compare the published SHA-256 value before running the package.

faqs.question: Does the in-app Shop process payment or deliver products?
faqs.answer: No. Shop is a read-only Zal Digital catalog. Product checkout, payment, delivery, and Store Support continue through the official Telegram bot. LiveFlow Studio does not store transaction data.
